rules.text: A change to headings 7501 through 7504 from any other heading, including another heading within that group.
A change to subheadings 7505.11 through 7505.12 from any other heading.

(A) A change to subheadings 7505.21 through 7505.22 from any other heading; or
(B) A change to subheadings 7505.21 through 7505.22 from subheadings 7505.11 through 7505.12, whether or not there is also a change from any other heading, provided that, if bar or rod is used, the cross-sectional area of the bar or rod is reduced by at least 50 percent.
A change to tariff item 7506.10.05 from any other tariff item.
A change to tariff item 7506.20.05 from any other tariff item.
A change to heading 7506 from any other heading.
A change to subheadings 7507.11 through 7508.90 from any other subheading, including another subheading within that group.
